channels_owner_scope_check.name: channels_owner_scope_check
channels_owner_scope_check.value:
(
    ("channels"."owner_kind" = 'platform' AND "channels"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "channels"."access_scope" IN ('all', 'restricted'))
    OR
    ("channels"."owner_kind" = 'user' AND "channels"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."access_scope" = 'private')
  )

sms_receiver_bindings_account_kind_check.name: sms_receiver_bindings_account_kind_check
sms_receiver_bindings_account_kind_check.value: not ("sms_receiver_bindings"."account_id" is not null and "sms_receiver_bindings"."pool_account_id" is not null)
